exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The reason is an absence, not a missed value, and the datasheet shows the opposite. SLUSE66A (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25731.pdf, read 2026-10-02T15:50:42Z) Figures 10-4 and 10-5 (page 89) are captioned '2-cell without battery', power up from 20 V and from 5 V: VSYS (5 V per division) steps up to about 8.4 V with no battery on a 2S setting from a 5 V VBUS. Figure 10-1, 'Application Diagram of BQ25731 with Non Power Path', puts the system load on the converter output SYS and the RSR (5 mOhm or 10 mOhm) between SYS and BATT; the feature list states 'No battery MOSFET'. 9.3.17: the input powers the system and the charge, charge current falls to zero as the system load rises. 'No BATFET' is a topology, so the cells' current crosses RSR and the load sits on the VSYS side (termination on the cells' current). CELL_BATPRESZ is a divider-biased pin (2S = 40 % of VDDA, Table 9-2) pulled low only to signal battery removal; the board never needs to drive it, and a held-off pack is not a removal at that pin. The 5 mOhm input-limit table P2 cited concerns RAC; RAC and RSR are set independently (9.3.5, RSNS_RAC = 0 for 10 mOhm gives 50 mA steps to 6.35 A, so 500 mA, 1.5 A and 3 A are settable). Other values read from the same datasheet: VBUS 3.5 to 26 V; 1 to 5 cells; 8.4 V at +-0.6 % (upper edge 8.4504 V); charge current to 16.256 A at 5 mOhm with accuracy stated at 5 mOhm (-5 % / +6 % at 4096 mA, -12 % / +13.5 % at 2048 mA); SRP-SRN -0.5 to 0.5 V recommended (0.261 V at 52.1 A, 0.3485 V at 69.7 A); TJ -20 to 125 C; no BATFET, so no gate-drive figure at the floor. exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The requirement is an average current a cell, and in external mode that current is set by the external network, not stated by the part: SLUSBV4D 7.3.2.4.2 offers external balancing as the faster option, and SLUUBT5C 8.2 gives the balance time with Rext in parallel (Figure 8-4 schematic), the same way the BQ29209's current is set by its external FET network, which P2 accepts for rank 1. One cell at a time is enough, since only the higher cell is bled. A datasheet silent on a figure that the external resistor decides is not a miss. The part's data (read 2026-10-02T15:58:09Z): balancing while charging or at rest, VCC 2.2 to 32 V. What remains is SLUUBT5C 8.1: the balance time is calculated only after a field-updated QMax (Update Status 0E). That is a learning condition, not a requirement value, and no earlier reason cites a figure that it misses. The application note 'Fast Cell Balancing Using External MOSFET' is not read, so no current is shown either way. Stock as read: JLCPCB 8611 (2026-10-02T16:01:51Z), Digi-Key 6515 (cached 11:58:04Z).
